# FIRE (Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression)

> > Defending free speech, academic freedom, and First Amendment rights on college campuses and beyond.

FIRE is a nonpartisan nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting individual rights in higher education and society. The organization provides legal advocacy, campus ratings, educational resources, and produces podcasts including 'So to Speak: The Free Speech Podcast' and 'Clear and Present Danger: A History of Free Speech.'

## Key Topics

- First Amendment
- Academic freedom
- Campus censorship
- Free speech rights
- Supreme Court cases
- Faculty rights
- Higher education policy
- DEI statements
- Content moderation
- Outrage mobs
- Student expression
- Comedy and censorship
- Free speech history
- Platform regulation
- Trigger warnings

## Legal Victories and Campus Advocacy

- [Victory for Free Speech at William & Mary](https://www.fire.org/news/victory-free-speech-william-mary): FIRE victory: William & Mary allows affirmative action bake sale to proceed
- [FIRE Shines New 'Spotlight' on Campus Censorship](https://www.fire.org/news/fire-shines-new-spotlight-campus-censorship): FIRE launches Spotlight: The Campus Freedom Resource database and ratings
- [Prof. Clemens and FIRE Bring Down a New-Age Loyalty Oath](https://www.fire.org/news/prof-clemens-and-fire-bring-down-new-age-loyalty-oath): FIRE victory: Monterey Peninsula College drops diversity curriculum mandate
- [Breaking Majority Opinion: Mahanoy Area School District v. B.L., 594 U.S. __ (2021)](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/free-speech-out-loud/breaking-majority-opinion-mahanoy-area-school-district-v-bl-594): Podcast reading of Supreme Court opinion on student off-campus social media

## So to Speak: Free Speech Podcast

- [The First Amendment at the Supreme Court](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/first-amendment-supreme-court-0): FIRE lawyers preview consequential Supreme Court First Amendment term
- [Judge Richard Posner on the First Amendment](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/judge-richard-posner-first-amendment): So to Speak interview with Judge Richard Posner on First Amendment issues
- [Trigger warnings and DEI statements](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/trigger-warnings-and-dei-statements): So to Speak with Amna Khalid on trigger warnings and DEI hiring statements
- ['Is this the day the Internet dies?'](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/day-internet-dies): So to Speak on internet censorship and social media content moderation
- [Words, Violence, and Censorship at Williams College](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/words-violence-and-censorship-williams-college): So to Speak with Williams College Prof. Luana Maroja on campus censorship
- [LGBT equality and the First Amendment](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/lgbt-equality-and-first-amendment): So to Speak with Prof. Carlos Ball on LGBT rights and First Amendment
- [The government's money, the government's rules?](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/governments-money-governments-rules): So to Speak podcast on Trump admin funding threats to Columbia and Northwestern
- ['Private Censorship' with J.P. Messina](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/private-censorship-jp-messina): So to Speak with J.P. Messina on private censorship and platform regulation

## Cancel Culture and Comedy

- [Outrage mobs in comedy](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/outrage-mobs-comedy): So to Speak podcast on cancel culture and outrage mobs in comedy clubs
- ['The Trials of Lenny Bruce'](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/trials-lenny-bruce): So to Speak podcast on Lenny Bruce's obscenity trials and comedy censorship

- [The Caliphate](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/clear-and-present-danger-history-free-speech/caliphate): Clear and Present Danger podcast on free speech in medieval Abbasid Caliphate

- [Censorship pandemic](https://www.fire.org/news/podcasts/so-speak-free-speech-podcast/censorship-pandemic): So to Speak podcast with Jacob Mchangama on coronavirus censorship globally
